caption:
Your CRM should not answer every message the same way.

Some moments need to move instantly. Some moments need a real person. Most shops get this backwards: slow on the easy stuff, silent on the moments that decide the sale.

Four zones, one rule for each:
1. Speed Zone - first response, always automated
2. Info Zone - repeat questions, always automated
3. Decision Zone - objections and comparisons, always human
4. Recovery Zone - the silent leads, always scheduled

Pull your last 20 leads and tag which zone each one fell into. You'll see exactly where the breakdown happens.
